tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search ZeroWidth product documentation. Returns matching pages with title, slug, public URL, and a query-relevant snippet. tools.name: workbench_flows_schedules_update

tools.name: workbench_flows_schedules_delete
tools.description: Removes a schedule for good. Prefer workbench_flows_schedules_update with enabled: false when the user might want it back. May return `needs_confirmation`.

tools.name: workbench_flows_schedules_run_now
tools.description: Runs one iteration of a schedule immediately through the real scheduled pipeline (same input, same delivery — the email or channel it normally posts to) without moving its cadence. tools.name: workbench_flows_shares_list
tools.description: Every guest link on one flow, newest first: label, whether it's still live, the shareUrl (live links only — dead ones have no URL), expiry, and how many guests and messages it has seen. Use it to answer 'who has access', to recover a link the user lost, and to get the shareId for workbench_flows_sha

tools.name: workbench_flows_shares_revoke
tools.description: Kills one guest link immediately — anyone holding it gets a closed page from then on. Conversations already had stay in the flow's history. Get the shareId from workbench_flows_shares_list. May return `needs_confirmation`.

tools.name: workbench_flows_run

tools.name: workbench_executions_get

tools.name: workbench_kb_get
tools.description: One knowledge base: name, recipe (docs / tabular / graph), status, document and chunk counts, embedding model, and ingestion settings. Read it to confirm a KB has content before pointing a flow at it. Get the kbId from workbench_kb_list.

tools.name: workbench_kb_documents_list
tools.description: Every document ingested into the KB's current content: id, name, type, size, chunk count. tools.name: workbench_kb_delete
tools.description: Deletes a knowledge base and everything in it. Flows that search it will find nothing — check which agents use it (the user knows; the KB page in Workbench lists them) and say so before proposing. May return `needs_confirmation`.

tools.name: workbench_kb_document_delete
tools.description: Removes one ingested document and all its chunks; searches stop returning it at once. Get the documentId from workbench_kb_documents_list. To replace a document, remove it then workbench_kb_add_documents the new version. May return `needs_confirmation`.

tools.name: workbench_kb_list
tools.description: Lists every knowledge base in the active workspace the caller can see. Returns summaries (id, name, description, status, doc/chunk counts, embedding model). Use an id with `workbench_kb_search` to retrieve content.

tools.name: workbench_kb_search
tools.description: Retrieves the most relevant chunks from one knowledge base — the core RAG primitive. `mode:"semantic"` (default) embeds the query and ranks by meaning (spends a small amount of workspace credit); `mode:"keyword"` is a free case-insensitive substring match. Each hit carries the chunk text, its docume

tools.name: workbench_kb_create
tools.description: Creates an empty knowledge base. Recipe 'docs' (default) for reference material an agent searches at runtime; 'tabular' for spreadsheet-style data queried with SQL; 'graph' for entity/relationship extraction. After creating, add content with workbench_kb_add_documents, then attach the KB to an agent

tools.name: workbench_kb_add_documents
tools.description: Adds documents to a knowledge base and starts ingestion (chunk + embed; graph KBs also extract entities; tabular KBs load CSV as tables). tools.name: workbench_shim_list
tools.description: Every shim the user can see: id, name, the question it answers, how many answers and examples it has, and the published version's held-out accuracy (null until something is published). tools.name: workbench_shim_get

tools.name: workbench_shim_add_answer
tools.description: Adds one answer (a label and, optionally, when it applies). The shim needs three examples of it before it builds again with the new answer. May return `needs_confirmation`.

tools.name: workbench_shim_add_examples
tools.description: Adds example inputs to one answer. tools.name: comments_list

tools.name: comments_create

Use it to leave findings where the discussion already lives (an eval result on the flow being debated, a summary on a long thread). Mention people via mentionedUserIds (from workspace member ids) to ring their not

tools.name: comments_resolve
tools.description: Sets a comment thread's resolved state (rootId = the thread's root comment id). Resolve ONLY when the human asked or the thread's question is demonstrably settled — and say what settled it in a reply first. Reopening is for new evidence.

tools.name: workbench_tasks_get
tools.description: One Task in full: its sentence, status, the latest saved plan (the clauses — which run flows, which zv1 handles, who decides at each gate) with the flow and people names the plan refers to, and its recent runs. tools.name: workbench_tasks_update
tools.description: Changes a task's name — the gallery label only. The sentence and plan are versioned and change through workbench_tasks_compile + workbench_tasks_freeze, never here. May return `needs_confirmation`.

tools.name: workbench_tasks_delete
tools.description: Deletes a task. Runs still in flight are stopped (a gate waiting on someone is closed), and its schedule trigger stops firing; past runs stay in history. Check workbench_tasks_get for live runs and say so before proposing. May return `needs_confirmation`.

tools.name: workbench_tasks_list
tools.description: Lists the workspace's Tasks — sentence-orchestrated processes — with their sentence, status, and recent runs (id, status, who a waiting run is on). Use this to find a task the user names ('claims intake') and to see what's in flight; workbench_tasks_get reads one in full.

tools.name: workbench_tasks_create
tools.description: Creates a DRAFT Task from a name + sentence. Use this once the user's sentence feels settled after you've refined it together — then compile it. The sentence should be THEIR words: trigger first ('When a claim arrives…'), then steps, branches, and who decides what.

tools.name: workbench_tasks_compile
tools.description: Runs the compiler over a sentence and returns the PROPOSED plan (or repair-grade problems — fix by refining the sentence with the user, not by guessing). Nothing persists. Present the proposal in plain terms: which clauses run flows, which you (zv1) will handle, who decides, what the compiler noted.

tools.name: workbench_tasks_freeze

Cite the run id back and tell the user what happens next (the run may immediately be waiting on someone).

tools.name: workbench_tasks_run_view
tools.description: The run's current state rendered as its sentence: what ran (with timings), which path each gate took, what's waiting on whom and for how long, what's coming up. Use whenever the user asks where something stands, and after acting on a gate.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "workbench" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_docs, workbench_flows_schedules_run_now, workbench_flows_shares_list, workbench_flows_scaffold, workbench_flows_share_create, comments_list, search_workspace · Private data: workbench_flows_run, workbench_executions_get, workbench_flow_authoring_guide, workbench_flows_share_create, workbench_kb_get, workbench_kb_documents_list, workbench_kb_ingestion_status, workbench_kb_document_delete, workbench_kb_search, workbench_kb_add_documents, workbench_tasks_start, workbench_tasks_act, search_workspace · Public sink: workbench_flows_publish, workbench_flows_delete, workbench_flows_schedules_run_now, workbench_flows_schedule, workbench_flows_scaffold, workbench_flows_share_create · Destructive: workbench_flows_publish, workbench_flows_delete, workbench_flows_schedules_list, workbench_flows_schedules_delete, workbench_flows_schedules_run_now, workbench_flows_run, workbench_flows_schedule, workbench_executions_get, workbench_flow_authoring_guide, workbench_flows_edit_text, workbench_flows_share_create, workbench_kb_ingestion_status, workbench_kb_delete, workbench_kb_document_delete, comments_create, workbench_tasks_get, workbench_tasks_delete, workbench_tasks_list, workbench_tasks_compile, workbench_tasks_freeze, workbench_tasks_start, workbench_tasks_run_view, workbench_tasks_act.
